lesson.menu_title: Hotels, Reservations, and Handling Problems Like a Pro -- A Hotel in Lyon
lesson.menu_desc: A late arrival in Lyon: a double-booked room, a leak, and a bill with a mistake. Talk to the manager, check your bill, and say what is being done and what has been done with the passive ('Your room is being cleaned', 'The leak has been fixed') -- 35 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 27 -- Hotels, Reservations, and Handling Problems Like a Pro
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Lucimara | Lesson 27 -- Handling Problems Like a Pro
lesson.grammar_point: passive voice with being and been (is being done / has been done)

listenings.text: Good evening, and welcome to the Hotel Rhone Lumiere. Here is some important information for your stay this week. The swimming pool is under renovation, and it will be closed until Friday. Our fourth floor is also being renovated, but the work only happens between nine a.m. and five p.m. Breakfast is being served in the garden restaurant this week, because the main restaurant is being painted. Your room has been cleaned and checked. If you find a problem, like a leak or a broken light, please call the front desk by pressing zero. A hold of one hundred and fifty euros has been placed on your card for incidentals. It will be released three days after you check out. Thank you, and enjoy your stay in Lyon.

I'm a corporate travel manager, and every week one of our travelers calls me with a hotel problem. Here is my advice. First, stay calm and be specific. Don't say, everything is terrible. Say, the air conditioning hasn't been fixed, and I asked two times. Second, ask for the name of the person who is helping you, and ask what is being done right now. Third, check your bill before you leave. Last month, one of our engineers was overcharged for three nights of parking, and he didn't even have a car! Finally, if the problem is serious, ask for a goodwill gesture. Most hotels will offer a discount, a free breakfast, or an upgrade. They want a good review, and you want a good night's sleep.

extra_audio.text: First, I explain the problem calmly and give my room number. Then, I ask the agent to look into it and to tell me what is being done. Next, I ask if a new room has been prepared for me. After that, I check my bill and make sure I wasn't overcharged. Finally, I ask for a goodwill gesture if the problem was serious.
